name: importable-sessions-skip-nested-repository
goal: `importableSessions` lists a project's native runtime sessions not yet in Pantheon. Today it also lists sessions whose working directory is inside a separate git repository nested under a project root (e.g. `<root>/inner` with its own `.git`). Leave those out: keep a session only when the git top-level of its `cwd` is one of the project roots, or when its `cwd` is in no git repository.
